files.ui/style.css: *{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -20%,#17301f 0,#0a100d 42%,#070a08 100%);color:#dce8dd;font:16px/1.55 system-ui,sans-serif;min-height:100vh}.shell{max-width:760px;margin:auto;padding:30px 20px 44px}header{border-bottom:1px solid #26382b;padding-bottom:18px;margin-bottom:20px}.eyebrow,.tag{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#79d28a;font-weight:700}h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,9vw,3.8rem);letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1;margin:12px 0 4px;color:#f2fff3}h1 span{color:#8dff54}.sub{margin:0;color:#91a995;letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:.8rem}.mission,.panel,.inventory{border:1px solid #294532;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#101a13ee,#0b110dee);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px;margin:14px 0;box-shadow:0 8px 32px #0005}.mission{border-left:3px solid #8dff54}.mission p{margin:8px 0 0;color:#bac9bc}.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center}.location{color:#9baea0;font-size:.84rem}h2{color:#9bff68;margin:15px 0 6px;font-size:1.4rem}#story{color:#c1cec3;min-height:3em}.choices{display:grid;gap:9px;margin-top:18px}button{font:inherit;text-align:left;color:#e9f5e9;background:#15231a;border:1px solid #3a6042;border-radius:9px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}button:hover,button:focus-visible{border-color:#9bff68;background:#1b3021;outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #8dff5433}button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}.inventory{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}.items{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.item,.empty{border:1px solid #34523a;border-radius:99px;padding:4px 10px;color:#a9e7a2;font-size:.85rem}.empty{color:#819084;border-style:dashed}#status{min-height:1.5em;color:#a8ff83;text-align:center}.win{color:#aaff76!important;text-shadow:0 0 16px #72ff4c66}footer{text-align:center;color:#65756a;font-size:.78rem;margin-top:24px}@media(min-width:600px){.choices{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
